name: Axis Co.,Ltd.
summary: Axis Co., Ltd. researches, develops, sells and manages computer systems, offering system integration that spans network design, infrastructure construction, cloud migration, low code development, nearshore development, and operation and maintenance. Its products include KITARO, a smart reception service, and Servive, a core system for running debt collection. It serves government, electric power and aviation fields. Incorporated in 1991, it has its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
